gdpr.export: Homecoming: the town chosen for the weather, and its point rounded to about a kilometre.
gdpr.erase: Homecoming: the town chosen for the weather is deleted.

weather.use_location: Use my location for the weather (town names © OpenStreetMap contributors)

guest.title: New here? Pull up a chair.
guest.body: Join to follow discussions, hear about replies, and post your own.

settings.heading: Weather
settings.help: Your welcome strip can show the weather where you are. Pick a town, or let your browser say where you are; either way only the town is kept, never your exact location.
settings.osm: Town names for your location: © OpenStreetMap contributors.
settings.using_map: Showing the weather for {place}, your Member Map place.
settings.using_default: Showing the forum's weather for {place}. Pick your own town, or use your location.
settings.none: Pick a town to see its weather on your welcome strip.
settings.unavailable: The town search isn't reachable right now. Try again in a few minutes.

settings.placement_help: Without a widget host, the strip sits above the discussion list. Placing any Homecoming piece in FoF Widgets, Page Builder or Bespoke hides this copy while that piece is on the page.
settings.placement_none: Only where a widget host places it
settings.stats_help: The four numbers on the stats card and the compact card. A stat that needs an extension you don't have is replaced by the next one that works.

stat_options.best_answers: Best answers (Answers or FoF Best Answer)

settings.unread_days: Count unread discussions from the last
settings.unread_days_help: In days. Older discussions a member never opened aren't counted, so a long-time member isn't told about years of threads.
settings.guest_nudge_help: Off, guests see nothing from Homecoming.
settings.weather_help: For members who set a town (or a Member Map place). The forum fetches it from Open-Meteo in the background, at most once every 30 minutes per area; only the area's rounded coordinates are sent.
settings.weather_unit_help: Members can choose their own in their settings.
settings.geolocate_help: A small button beside the weather. Only when a member clicks it does their browser ask where they are; the point is rounded to about a kilometre before it leaves the browser, and only the town is kept (looked up on OpenStreetMap).
settings.default_town_help: For members with no town of their own and no Member Map place. Type a town (for example Nashville, Tennessee) and save; leave it empty for no default.
settings.weather_cap: Weather fetches per minute, at most
settings.weather_cap_help: For the whole forum. Members whose area isn't fetched yet see no weather until the next one.
